tools.name: delta_lookup_red_item
tools.description: Look up Delta Force red collectibles by Chinese name, part of a name, category or catalog ID. Omit query to list all names. Similar items include distinguishing details. Use an item's catalog ID with includeImage to see its reference picture.

tools.name: delta_inspect_loot
tools.description: Read the native-resolution item slot and its name area from a recent loot event. Use that observation's id. This reads the original event pixels and takes no new screenshot.

description.zh: 校准区域的观察结果及同帧完整截图与裁图
description.en: Observations from calibrated regions with full and cropped images from one frame
